title: What's the time?
description: A bilingual lesson built around 12 numbered clocks and 10 dated place illustrations (church, school, the office, the butcher's, the hairdresser's, the baker's, the dairy, home, the grocer's, the greengrocer's) that practise the 'Where were you on ...?' and 'When were you at ...?' structures. Includes workbook day-of-week ordering, was/wasn't fill-ins, at-the prepositions, and open-ended personal answers, plus grammar on where-/when-questions with was/were. 以12幅编号时钟和10幅带日期的地点插图为主的双语课，练习「……你在什么地方？」和「你什么时候在……？」句型。配合教材星期排序、was/wasn't 填空、at the 介词练习和自答练习，以及 where/when 问句和 was/were 的语法练习。
answer_note: Workbook A (days of the week) and C (at the) answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 68 key (img/key-067-072.jpg); workbook B fill-in answers are constructed from the printed dialogue and labelled suggested; workbook D personal answers are open-ended and labelled suggested. Textbook written-exercise answers are constructed from standard English usage and the printed example and labelled suggested. Grammar answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 68 grammar key (PDF viewer page 499). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。

Where were you on ...? ……你在什么地方？
When were you at ...? 你什么时候在……？
lesson.translation: Listen and answer the questions. Where were you on ...? When were you at ...?

lesson.title: Written exercise A Complete these sentences using the where necessary.
lesson.instruction: Complete these sentences using the where necessary. 完成以下句子，必要时填上定冠词 the。
lesson.translation: Complete each sentence, adding 'the' where necessary.
lesson.context: No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from standard English usage (the + place names that take the definite article) and labelled suggested. Blank for 'the' is filled with 'the', blank with no article is filled with '—'.

questions.prompt: I was at ______ church on Sunday.
I was at ______ office on Monday.
My son was at ______ school on Tuesday.
My wife was at ______ butcher's on Wednesday.
She was at ______ grocer's on Thursday.
My daughter was in ______ country on Friday.
I was at ______ home on Saturday.

lesson.title: Written exercise B Write questions and answers using he/she and at/on.
lesson.instruction: Write questions and answers using he/she and at/on. 模仿例句提问并回答。
lesson.translation: Write a question and a full answer for each set of cues, following the printed example.
lesson.context: The printed example (he/church/Sunday → When was he at church? He was at church on Sunday.) is not editable. Items 1-6 follow the same pattern; the question and answer are each one field. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: he/church/Sunday
questions.answer: When was he at church? He was at church on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Tom/the hairdresser's/Thursday
questions.answer:
When was Tom at the hairdresser's?
He was at the hairdresser's on Thursday.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Jones/the butcher's/Wednesday
questions.answer:
When was Mrs. Jones at the butcher's?
She was at the butcher's on Wednesday.

questions.prompt: he/home/Sunday
questions.answer:
When was he at home?
He was at home on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Penny/the baker's/Friday
questions.answer:
When was Penny at the baker's?
She was at the baker's on Friday.

questions.prompt: Mrs. Williams/the grocer's/Monday
questions.answer:
When was Mrs. Williams at the grocer's?
She was at the grocer's on Monday.

questions.prompt: Nicola/the office/Tuesday
questions.answer:
When was Nicola at the office?
She was at the office on Tuesday.

practice.title: A The days of the week
practice.instruction: These are the days of the week. Write them in the correct order. 按照正确的顺序写出一周中的 7 天。
practice.translation: Write the seven days of the week in the correct order, starting on Monday.
practice.context: The printed word bank is: Wednesday Friday Monday Tuesday Saturday Thursday Sunday. The printed example shows 'Sunday' circled as one of the days. The key lists the seven days in order starting on Monday.

questions.prompt: Write the seven days of the week in the correct order (starting on Monday).
questions.answer: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday

practice.title: B Structure
practice.instruction: Fill in was, wasn't or were in these sentences. 用 was, wasn't 或 were 填空。
practice.translation: Fill in the correct form (was, wasn't or were) in each blank.
practice.context: The workbook key does not cover this exercise in a directly usable form; the answers are constructed from standard English usage and the sentence context and labelled suggested.

questions.prompt: ______ you at church on Sunday? – No, I ______. I was at home.
Where was your Dad on Friday? – He ______ at the office.
I ______ in the country at the weekend. I was at home.
Where ______ you on Wednesday? – I wasn't at the baker's. I ______ at the butcher's.
My sister ______ at school on Tuesday. She was at home.

practice.title: C At or at the
practice.instruction: What do we say in English – at or at the? Write in at or at the. 用 at 或 at the 填空。
practice.translation: Fill in each blank with 'at' or 'at the'.
practice.context: The key lists 12 items (1 at the, 2 at, 3 at the, 4 at the, 5 at, 6 at the, 7 at the, 8 at the, 9 at the, 10 at the, 11 at, 12 at the). The printed exercise shows 11 blanks (items 2-12 in the key's numbering); item 1 of the key is not part of the printed exercise and is not editable here.

practice.title: D About you
practice.instruction: Answer these questions with short answers or full sentences. 用简短形式或完整句子回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Answer each question with a short answer or a full sentence about yourself.
practice.context: Personal-answer questions; no official key is supplied. The supplied key offers one possible model answer for each item; the full set of possible answers is open-ended.

questions.prompt: Were you absent from school last week?
questions.answer: No, I wasn't. (or: Yes, I was. I was absent on Wednesday.)

questions.prompt: Where were you on Sunday?
questions.answer: I was at home on Sunday. (or: I was at church / at the office / at the grocer's / ...)

questions.prompt: Were you at the hairdresser's on Saturday?
questions.answer: No, I wasn't at the hairdresser's. I was in the country. (or: Yes, I was.)

Where was Emma at four o'clock on December 15th? (in her office)
Where were you at the weekend? (in the country)

Where was our teacher on Thursday? (in Beijing)
Where was Mary at noon on November 9th? (at the hairdresser's)
Where was the old woman on Sunday morning? (at church)

questions.prompt: When was she at the butcher's? (at eleven)

questions.prompt: When was the policewoman at the office? (on Wednesday)
questions.answer: She was at the office on Wednesday.

questions.prompt: When were you at the greengrocer's? (at nine)
questions.answer: I was at the greengrocer's at nine.
